task: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
layout: context plus four predicted temporal latent steps; 2 independent camera views

projection.normalization: per-token layer normalization (same representation used for the latent prediction target)
projection.pca_basis: one shared basis fitted over context and all four future steps for both camera views
projection.color_scale: one shared 1st-99th percentile scale per component

note: These are latent feature projections, not decoded RGB images.
